step.title: Add your investments
step.lead: Tell us what you own and where. Vera adds it all up, in reais or dollars, and compares it with the portfolio you consider ideal.
step.why1Detail: Brazil, US and crypto in a single currency, split by type: fixed income, stocks, REITs, crypto.
step.why2Detail: E.g. "you hold 18% in US stocks and wanted 25%". Without knowing what you own, there is nothing to compare.
step.why3Detail: Smart contribution splits each new deposit to bring the portfolio closer to the target, without selling anything.
step.noteText: There is no free, reliable way to pull positions from every broker, foreign bank and exchange. You only enter the quantity; values update on their own every day from market quotes or the index.
step.cardDetail: Pick an investment type. Start with the biggest ones; you can finish later in "My assets".
